cases.purpose: recursive download succeeds when the remote tar stream has trailing record padding
cases.setup_script:
ADAPTER_SOURCE=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-copy-ssh-r3.py
ADAPTER_TARGET=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-copy-adapter
/usr/bin/install -m 0755 "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET"
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$ADAPTER_TARGET" > "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
/usr/bin/stat -c "mode=%a uid=%u" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" >> "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
read -r adapter_sha adapter_name < "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
[[ $adapter_sha == f6dee76b2c4bdaa9ac65dae7bee2881d8645d14a3063600665cca2f6a2e927d4 && -x "$ADAPTER_TARGET" ]] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" || { echo "CONTROL-FAILED adapter copy/hash/mode"; exit 98; }
H=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-copy-adapter
FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT="$HOME/control-remote"
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"control","mode":"scp","fail":false}' > "$HOME/copy-config.json"
mkdir -p "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" remote
[[ -x "$H" && -x /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED missing executable'; exit 98; }
"$H" fixture pwd > "$HOME/control-command.out"
[[ $(/usr/bin/cat "$HOME/control-command.out") == "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED command adapter'; exit 98; }
printf 'control-copy\n' > "$HOME/control-input"
/usr/bin/scp -S "$H" "$HOME/control-input" fixture:control-copy > "$HOME/control-client.out" 2> "$HOME/control-client.err"
/usr/bin/cmp "$HOME/control-input" "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT/control-copy" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED OpenSSH scp over sftp-server'; exit 98; }
mkdir downloads
chmod 751 'remote/source tree/nested'
chmod 640 'remote/source tree/nested/one file'
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"case","mode":"scp","fail":false}' > "$HOME/copy-case-config.json"
/usr/bin/install -m 0600 "$HOME/copy-case-config.json" "$HOME/copy-config.json"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/copy-case-config.json" "$HOME/copy-config.json" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED configuration copy'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/cp "$HOME/copy-invocations.jsonl" "$HOME/control-invocations.jsonl"
: > "$HOME/copy-invocations.jsonl"
/usr/bin/cat > /tmp/parity-case/padded-copy-adapter <<'PYADAPTER'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import os, subprocess, sys
adapter = '/tmp/parity-case/fixture-copy-adapter'
if sys.argv[-1].startswith('tar -cf - -C '):
    result = subprocess.run([adapter, *sys.argv[1:]], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
    if result.returncode == 0:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes(1024 * 1024))
    sys.exit(result.returncode)
os.execv(adapter, [adapter, *sys.argv[1:]])
PYADAPTER
/usr/bin/chmod 0755 /tmp/parity-case/padded-copy-adapter
cases.comparison: Compare status, tree paths, contents and modes against OpenSSH; candidate transport adds 1 MiB of zero padding after the tar archive.
cases.oracle: OpenSSH scp over the independent OpenSSH sftp-server via a local SSH-shaped adapter; candidate uses its command-stream adapter. The setup separately proves both adapter paths, with no network or authentication claim.
cases.candidate_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
H=/tmp/parity-case/padded-copy-adapter
export BASHSSH_OPENSSH_BIN="$H"
builtin scp --openssh -r "fixture:source tree" downloads > "$HOME/client.stdout" 2> "$HOME/client.stderr"
rc=$?
printf "status=%s\n" "$rc"
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PYP'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-home'); e=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'copy-invocations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
stages=[x['event'] for x in e]
valid='invoked' in stages and 'configured' in stages and 'error' not in stages
valid=valid and any(x in stages for x in ('command','sftp-server','tree-stream','stock-proxy'))
valid=valid and all(x.get('error') is None and x.get('status')==0 for x in e if x['event']=='proxy-finished')
print('peer-stage=observed' if valid else 'peer-stage=unobserved')
PYP
